data.name: Assassin's Venom
data.description: You gain a bonus on the save DC of prevenom or prevenom weapon equal to the competence bonus granted by your trance class feature.
prerequisites: PREABILITY:1,CATEGORY=Special Ability,Assassin's Path ~ First,Assassin's Path ~ Second
PREABILITY:1,CATEGORY=Special Ability,Prevenom Path Power,Prevenom Weapon Path Power
